conditions.execution: Sequential, no concurrent builds or tests launched during timing; code fingerprint unchanged. Two repeats with reversed configuration order, no cooldown between runs. Later phone samples are warmed-device evidence.
limits: Eight-second motion stages are broad coverage, not rare-hitch or GC attribution.
Motion compares the same arrival/seed/zoom but actual trajectory and actor time can differ; start/end/travel are recorded.
Each zoom starts after game readiness/settings selection, not navigation cold start.
A 30-second catch-up limit plus 60 quiet render frames defines the gate; failure is retained.
Benchmark instrumentation adds work; rAF intervals are not hardware presentation counters.
Thermal status increased on the phone; renderer/policy differences cannot be cleanly separated from temperature and order effects.
GPU means WebGL2 sprites without meshes; no mesh-heavy, indoor, WebGPU gameplay, Rust, iOS or lower-end coverage.
